This implies that Antoninus Pius is the fourth of the Five Good Emperors.

   - Finally, locate the lifespan of Antoninus Pius to answer the question. The paragraph titled "Antoninus Pius" provides his lifespan as 19 September 86 to 7 March 161 AD. Thus, Antoninus Pius, the third of the Five Good Emperors, lived from 19 September 86 to 7 March 161 AD.
